note: Hold the dots and slide: the sunrise flipbook, ending on a morning verse in the sky.
title: Good morning

entries.text: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail. They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.
